# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Block placement, round 1: what each kind of block's getStateForPlacement reads (the clicked face, the click's height,
# the player's yaw or look), the placement context's API, the item's placement path, the client's use-on call, who else
# places through BlockItem#place (a dispenser's shulker box: no player), and the render events a preview could use.
calls net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem ^place$|^getPlacementState$|^updatePlacementContext$|^canPlace$|^placeBlock$|^useOn$
sig net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext
sig net.minecraft.world.item.context.UseOnContext
sig net.minecraft.world.item.context.DirectionalPlaceContext
calls net.minecraft.core.dispenser.ShulkerBoxDispenseBehavior .
calls net.minecraft.world.level.block.RotatedPillarBlock ^getStateForPlacement$
